title: Why mint feels cold
question: Why does mint feel icy without making anything colder?
takeaway: Mint does not lower temperature. Menthol activates cold receptors, so your brain reads the signal as cold.
mechanism: Menthol activates the TRPM8 cold receptor in the mouth and skin.

title: Why cold drains phone batteries
question: Why does phone battery drop faster in the cold?
takeaway: Cold slows ion movement, voltage drops, and the phone reports less battery.
mechanism: Low temperature increases resistance inside a lithium-ion battery. Ions move more slowly, so voltage falls under load and the phone reads that lower voltage as less remaining charge. Some apparent battery can return after warming.
